name: Mississippi
source: Mississippi Department of Revenue Individual Income Tax general information page (rate 0% on the first 10000 and 4% above for tax year 2026, exemptions and standard deductions), fetched 2026-10-22; second sources Bloomberg Tax (DOR 2026 rates, 7 January 2026) and EY Tax News 2025-0936 (HB 1 schedule)

state_base.note: Mississippi starts from federal adjusted gross (or taxable) income, so 401(k) deferrals, Traditional IRA deposits and HSA deposits stay deductible as on the federal return (confirmed primary: https://www.dor.ms.gov/sites/default/files/tax-forms/individual/80100251%202.pdf, validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

standard_deduction.note: Brackets: The joint table taxes the first 20000 at 0%: on a combined return each spouse computes the tax on their own share (DOR example), so 10000 each; this assumes each spouse has at least 10000 of taxable income. The rate falls to 3.75% in 2027 and 0.25 a year after (HB 1 of 2025), not modelled.

exemptions.note: DOR exemption chart: 6000 single, 12000 married (6000 each when separate), 1500 per dependent and per person aged 65 or older (or blind). Head of family 8000 not modelled.

retirement_exclusion.note: Pensions, annuities and IRA, Keogh and other qualified plan distributions are exempt once retired; early distributions are taxed (Miss. Code 27-7-15 as quoted in secondary sources; the age is taken as 59.5).

estate_inheritance.note: Mississippi has no estate tax (repealed for deaths from 2005) and no inheritance tax (state-costs.csv; Tax Foundation 2026 map). Confirmed primary on https://www.dor.ms.gov/business/estate (validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

social_security.note: Mississippi does not tax Social Security benefits; it is not among the states that tax them in Kiplinger 2026 (https://www.kiplinger.com/taxes/states-that-tax-social-security-benefits) and AARP, as listed in .claude/state/research/state-costs.md. Confirmed primary on https://www.dor.ms.gov/individual/individual-income-tax-frequently-asked-questions (validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

local_income_tax.check_at: Mississippi DOR: no local income taxes
local_income_tax.note: Mississippi cities, parishes and counties levy no income tax on individuals (state-costs.csv local_income_tax 'none'; Tax Foundation local income tax map).

sales_tax.check_at: Mississippi revenue department sales and use tax rate tables
sales_tax.source: Tax Foundation, State and Local Sales Tax Rates, Midyear 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/2026-sales-tax-rates-midyear/), as of 2026-07-01; groceries and clothing: https://www.dor.ms.gov/sites/default/files/Business/72-25-03%20New%205%25%20Sales%20Tax%20Rate%20on%20Groceries.pdf and https://zamp.com/blog/sales-tax-on-clothing
sales_tax.note: Rates as fractions; avg_local_rate is the combined less the state rate, at least 0. vehicle_rate is the purchase tax on a car: 0.05 from the state's own source (Mississippi 5% on cars and light trucks up to 10,000 lb (https://www.dor.ms.gov/business/sales-use-tax/sales-tax-rates, validation run 2)). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py. Groceries and clothing: grocery_rate is the state rate on groceries (0.05) plus the average local rate where locals tax them (locals: partly); research note: HB 1 (2025): groceries 7%->5% from 2025-07-01 (rate code 40); scheduled further phase-down; few local taxes (e.g. Jackson 1%). clothing_taxable is true (research: yes; taxed). Set by hand from .claude/state/research/grocery-tax.csv and clothing-tax.csv (s329).

property_tax.check_at: Census ACS 2024 1-year tables B25090 and B25082 at https://data.census.gov
property_tax.source: Census ACS 2024 1-year (B25090 / B25082) as compiled at https://floridaprobateandfamilylaw.com/blog/effective-property-tax-rates-by-state-2025/
property_tax.note: Effective rate: real-estate taxes paid divided by home value, owner-occupied homes. Senior relief, homestead caps and freezes are not in it (a buyer pays the full rate). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

home_insurance.source: Insurify state table for a 300,000 dwelling (https://insurify.com/homeowners-insurance/states/), October 2026
home_insurance.note: Average annual premium for a 300,000 dwelling. Quote averages differ by 20 to 40 percent between publishers, so the model uses it as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_insurance.source: Insurify full coverage, monthly times 12 (https://insurify.com/car-insurance/states/), October 2026
car_insurance.note: Average annual full-coverage premium. Used as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_taxes.check_at: Mississippi motor vehicle registration and vehicle property tax pages
car_taxes.source: WalletHub, 2026's Property Taxes by State, vehicle tax table (https://wallethub.com/edu/t/states-with-the-highest-and-lowest-property-taxes/11585/), read 2026-10-22
car_taxes.note: Annual vehicle tax on a 29100 car (2026 Toyota Camry LE): ad valorem tax on vehicles paid with the tag, among the highest in the country. One source, so unconfirmed; flat registration and title fees are not in it. Set by hand after .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py (which writes 0); rerunning the importer resets it.

fuel.source: Excise: https://www.dor.ms.gov/sites/default/files/business/Petroleum/Motor%20Fuel%20Distributor%20notice%204-30-25.pdf (validation run 2, 2026-10-22); price: USGasGauge state-by-year table (AAA data), 2024 annual average
fuel.note: gas_tax_per_gallon is the state excise in dollars, without sales tax on fuel: 0.24 from 2026-07-01 (HB 1 of 2025: 0.21 from 2025-07-01, 0.27 from 2027-07-01, then indexed); average_price_per_gallon is the 2024 average pump price (grade unclear, about regular). Set by hand from the primary source in validation run 2, 2026-10-22; importStateCosts.py keeps a hand-set section.

utilities.source: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B, residential price, January to July 2026
utilities.note: Average residential electricity price in dollars per kWh, January to July 2026 (a partial year). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

housing.check_at: https://fred.stlouisfed.org (Zillow Home Value Index by state) and https://meric.mo.gov/data/cost-living-data-series
housing.source: Zillow Home Value Index by state via FRED (September 2026); MERIC Cost of Living Data Series housing index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026
housing.note: typical_home_value is the Zillow Home Value Index (all homes, middle tier); cost_index is the MERIC housing cost index (US = 100), used to scale rent after a move. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

health_premiums.check_at: https://www.kff.org/affordable-care-act/state-indicator/average-marketplace-premiums-by-metal-tier/, Mississippi insurance department Medigap rate guide and the CMS MA Landscape and Part D files (https://www.cms.gov)
health_premiums.source: KFF Average Marketplace Premiums by Metal Tier 2026 (benchmark silver at 40, times the federal age curve 2.124 for 60); MoneyGeek Medicare Supplement Plan G at 65, 2026; KFF Average Monthly Premium for PDPs, 2024; MedicareSupplement.com analysis of the CMS 2026 MA Landscape files
health_premiums.note: Monthly premiums per person, unsubsidized list prices: aca_60_monthly is the benchmark silver plan at 60 (estimated from the age-40 figure), medigap_g_monthly Plan G at 65, part_d_monthly the enrollment-weighted Part D plan, medicare_advantage_monthly the average Medicare Advantage premium. Null means no usable figure; a move then leaves that premium unchanged. Used as ratios between states only. Research note: ACA state age curve: age-60 value uses federal curve (approx). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

price_indexes.source: MERIC Cost of Living Data Series grocery index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026; BEA Regional Price Parities by state, goods and other services (US = 100), 2024, release of 2026-02-19 via FRED
price_indexes.note: Price levels with US = 100: grocery_index is the MERIC grocery index, bea_goods and bea_services the BEA Regional Price Parities for goods and for services other than rent. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

long_term_care.source: Genworth / CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2024, Ranked State Data Tables, state medians (https://assets.carescout.com/a41bb6478c/298701.pdf)
long_term_care.note: State median monthly costs: a home health aide, an assisted living facility and a private nursing home room. Stored for reference; the model does not use them. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.
